newsitem.title: USA: YPF sells one mln bbls of Canadon Seco to Brazil.
newsitem.headline: YPF sells one mln bbls of Canadon Seco to Brazil.

text.p: Argentine YPF sold one million barrels of heavy, sweet Canadon Seco crude oil for late November delivery to Brazil, trade sources said Friday.
The sale at West Texas Intermediate minus $2.39 a barrel (fob) at the terminal was transacted in three parcels on Thursday.
YPF earlier targetted a price of WTI minus $1.95 a barrel, which includes the cost of lightering to a large vessel.
Separately, state-owned Colombian oil concern Ecopetrol was seen seeking bids for 550,000 barrels of Cusiana for November 21-25. U.S. refiners bought Cusiana this week at Dec WTI plus 10 cents (fob).
Prices were seen creeping higher due to tight supplies and a shut arbitrage for North Sea and West African crudes.
